sense: what you open to go into a room

pins.definition: A movable barrier used to open and close the entrance to a room, building, or vehicle, or the entrance itself.
A movable barrier used to block or open an entrance to a room or building.
A hinged or sliding panel for entering and leaving a room, building, or vehicle.

situation: A woman stands in a quiet hallway, grasping a polished brass handle and swinging a heavy wooden panel wide to step into a sunlit bedroom.
subject: the movable barrier of the door
brief: A tall wooden door stands half-swung on its brass hinges between a dimly lit corridor and a brightly sunlit room, its heavy panel clearly half-open to reveal the space beyond. One hand rests on the polished brass doorknob, mid-motion, showing the exact barrier used to open and close the entrance.
